_source: PLACEHOLDER script for the Collective opening's bar conversation (Collective-Opening-Design §6.4), in the owner's order: welcome, who the Collective are, the frontier, the offer, the terms, the handshake. The owner's transcript replaces the lines; slide ids stay. [MM-story_mw47llqj_6]

ledger.title: The Long Ledger
ledger.caption: Capital ship of the Collective · above Vesper

frontier.title: The frontier
frontier.caption: Nine homeworlds · nine factions · one market

terms.title: The terms
terms.caption: We buy to the quota · the surplus is yours

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Welcome aboard the Long Ledger, Commander. Mind the stools — they bolt them down after the last convoy.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I'm Mira Valcourt. I write the contracts on this ship, which makes me the most interesting person in the bar.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You'll hear a lot of things about the Collective out there. Most of them are true, and none of them are about guns.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: We're traders. We don't take worlds. We buy what comes out of them.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Nine homeworlds on this arm, nine factions, and every one of them sitting on resources they can't move without us.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: They'll fight each other over it. We'd rather they fought efficiently.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Which brings me to you. Verdance — green, loud, and rich in powder ore.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: The Ground faction holds it. Their harvest lines need a commander who can keep them standing.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: So here's the offer: a transport, fitted and fuelled, waiting in the Loading Bay.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: It's yours for as long as you keep a contract with us. Fair?

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: The terms are simple. Whatever you harvest, we buy — up to the quota.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Common ore and the uncommon finds. Anything past the quota, and anything rare, you keep.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Fill enough contracts and the Collective remembers your name. That's worth more than the gold.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Then we have a deal. Welcome to the Collective, Commander.
